constraints.name: capacity
constraints.forall: p in PLANTS, m in MONTHS

constraints.name: demand
constraints.expr: sum(p in PLANTS) make[p, m] >= demand[m]

constraints.name: maintenance
constraints.description: North is shut for maintenance in month 2.

constraints.name: road_limit
constraints.description: By road, east can ship at most 40 units in all.

constraints.name: west_balance
constraints.description: The plants other than east make at least 100 units in all.
constraints.expr: sum(p in PLANTS, m in MONTHS: p != 'east') make[p, m] >= 100

solve.objective: sum(p in PLANTS, m in MONTHS) cost[p] * make[p, m] + rail_fee * rail
